explicit_ACs: Header Bar: — Displays user's profile icon, name (e.g., "Nisal Gunasekara"), and role label (e.g., "User").
Header Bar: — Displays current time and date (e.g., "12:29 PM", "Sep 02, 2023"), updating in real time.
Header Bar: — Displays a settings (gear) icon in the top-right corner. — On click: navigates to the account/system settings page.
Sidebar Navigation: — Displays the BookWorm logo/icon at the top.
Sidebar Navigation: — Displays a vertical set of navigation icons (Dashboard, [module icon], Book Inventory).
Sidebar Navigation: — Displays a logout icon at the bottom of the sidebar. — On click: logs the user out and redirects to the login page.
Sidebar Navigation: — The currently active section is visually highlighted.
Quick Action Cards: — "Your Borrowed Book List" Card: Displays an icon and title. — On click: navigates to the page listing all books currently borrowed by the user.
Quick Action Cards: — "Your Returned Book List" Card: Displays an icon and title. — On click: navigates to the page listing the user's book return history.
Quick Action Cards: — "Let's browse available book inventory" Card: Displays an icon and title. — On click: navigates to the Book Inventory / catalog browsing page.
Brand Panel: — Displays "BookWorm Library" logo and name, centered between the quick action cards and the borrowing summary chart.
Quote Panel: — Displays a static motivational quote about reading, attributed to "~ BookWorm Team".
Quote Panel: — Quote content is sourced from a central configuration/CMS so it can be updated without code changes.
Borrowing Summary Chart: — Displays a pie/donut chart visualizing the proportion of "Total Borrowed Books" vs "Total Returned Books" for the logged-in user.
Borrowing Summary Chart: — Displays a legend below the chart with color-coded labels for "Total Borrowed Books" and "Total Returned Books".
Borrowing Summary Chart: — Chart data reflects the user's real-time borrowing record and updates when a book is borrowed or returned.
implicit_ACs: The 'Your Borrowed Book List' card displays a numeric count of the user's currently borrowed books alongside the icon and title.
The 'Your Returned Book List' card displays a numeric count of the user's returned books alongside the icon and title.
The Borrowing Summary section displays the actual numeric values for 'Total Borrowed Books' and 'Total Returned Books' alongside or within the chart, not only as proportional segments.
The header bar displays a visible profile avatar image or placeholder icon representing the logged-in user, distinct from the user's name text.
The main content area displays a visible page heading (e.g., 'Dashboard') identifying the current screen to the user.
Each sidebar navigation icon displays a visible text label or tooltip (e.g., 'Dashboard', 'Book Inventory') adjacent to or overlaying the icon to identify its destination.
The Quote Panel displays the full body text of the motivational quote as a statically visible string on the dashboard in its default state.
The Brand Panel displays both the BookWorm logo graphic and the 'BookWorm Library' name as visible, distinct elements centered in the panel.

all_discrepancies.description: The 'Your Borrowed Book List' card does not display any numeric count of currently borrowed books alongside the icon and title.
all_discrepancies.violated_criterion: The 'Your Borrowed Book List' card displays a numeric count of the user's currently borrowed books alongside the icon and title.
all_discrepancies.feedback: The 'Your Borrowed Book List Card' is missing from the design at Quick Action Cards - top left. This element is required by AC-01 and was not found in 5 out of 5 validation passes. QA engineers would expect this element to be present on this screen.

all_discrepancies.description: The chart legend only shows color-coded labels without any actual numeric values for Total Borrowed Books and Total Returned Books.
all_discrepancies.violated_criterion: The Borrowing Summary section displays the actual numeric values for 'Total Borrowed Books' and 'Total Returned Books' alongside or within the chart, not only as proportional segments.
all_discrepancies.feedback: The 'Borrowing Summary Chart Legend' is missing from the design at Borrowing Summary Chart - bottom right. This element is required by AC-02 and was not found in 5 out of 5 validation passes. QA engineers would expect this element to be present on this screen.

all_discrepancies.description: There is no visible page heading such as 'Dashboard' displayed in the main content area to identify the current screen.
all_discrepancies.violated_criterion: The main content area displays a visible page heading (e.g., 'Dashboard') identifying the current screen to the user.
all_discrepancies.feedback: The 'Page Heading' is missing from the design at main content area. This element is required by AC-04 and was not found in 5 out of 5 validation passes. QA engineers would expect this element to be present on this screen.

all_discrepancies.description: The sidebar navigation icons are displayed without any visible text labels or tooltips to identify their destinations.
all_discrepancies.violated_criterion: Each sidebar navigation icon displays a visible text label or tooltip (e.g., 'Dashboard', 'Book Inventory') adjacent to or overlaying the icon to identify its destination.
all_discrepancies.feedback: The 'Sidebar Navigation Icons' is missing from the design at sidebar navigation. This element is required by AC-05 and was not found in 5 out of 5 validation passes. QA engineers would expect this element to be present on this screen.

all_discrepancies.description: The header bar shows only a small generic icon next to the user's name without a distinct visible profile avatar image or placeholder that clearly represents the logged-in user.
all_discrepancies.violated_criterion: The header bar displays a visible profile avatar image or placeholder icon representing the logged-in user, distinct from the user's name text.
all_discrepancies.feedback: The 'User Profile Avatar' is missing from the design at top navigation. This element is required by AC-03 and was not found in 4 out of 5 validation passes. QA engineers would expect this element to be present on this screen.

all_discrepancies.description: None of the sidebar navigation icons appear to be visually highlighted to indicate the currently active section.
all_discrepancies.violated_criterion: The currently active section is visually highlighted.
all_discrepancies.feedback: The 'Sidebar Active State Highlight' is missing from the design at sidebar navigation. This element is required by AC-06 and was not found in 1 out of 5 validation passes. QA engineers would expect this element to be present on this screen.

all_discrepancies.description: The design does not provide any indication or annotation that the quote content is dynamically sourced from a CMS or central configuration rather than being hardcoded.
all_discrepancies.violated_criterion: Quote content is sourced from a central configuration/CMS so it can be updated without code changes.
all_discrepancies.feedback: The design of 'Quote Panel - CMS sourcing' at Quote Panel - bottom center violates a business rule defined in AC-07. This was flagged in 1 out of 5 validation passes, indicating a significant requirement deviation.
